decision: decisions.md §18 item 5 (17 Nov 2026, Devansh): development pilot under seed namespace 'p6-pilot' (disjoint from all split seeds) for every cohort cell, large enough to estimate each solvable rate within +-2 percentage points; measure generation throughput; from the pilot only, propose the candidate budget for 3,000 solvable training networks (rejection sampling in seed order, every candidate logged) and a fixed size per test cohort giving about 200 expected solvable tasks. Proposals only: Devansh decides.
tasks_rule: worst case p = 0.5: 1.96 * sqrt(0.25 / 2401) = 0.0200, so every cell's 95% interval half-width is at most 2 percentage points whatever its rate
registry: cohort parameters mirrored from configs/d28_cohorts.json on d28-pipe 79697c4 (P7); d28_test_ac is left out (Round 10: no AC-shift split; OQ-P7-3)

cves.training: exclude every training-pool CVE (core pool, no held-out product, minus the holdout): only held-out CVEs can become actions

training.rule: budget per size = smallest N with P(Binomial(N, r_low) >= 1500) >= 0.999, r_low the cell's Wilson 95% lower bound; 1,500 per size at n = 12 and 20 (registry) = 3,000

test_rule: fixed size per test cohort and size = ceil(200 / r), r the pilot cell's solvable rate (expected solvable 200)

cells.name: cve_all
cells.variant: held-out and training CVEs both allowed (OQ-P6-21)
